statement: WITH channel_summary AS (SELECT split, COUNT(*) AS n_channels, SUM(CASE WHEN topic_category_count > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_nonempty, ROUND(AVG(topic_category_count), 4) AS avg_label_cardinality, COUNT(DISTINCT first_topic_category) AS distinct_first_labels FROM dev_sean.matt.yt_channel_topic_taxonomy_channel_labels_20260612 GROUP BY split), edge_summary AS (SELECT edge_strength, COUNT(*) AS n_edges, ROUND(SUM(train_n_child_parent) / SUM(train_n_child), 4) AS weighted_train_confidence, ROUND(SUM(heldout_n_child_parent) / SUM(heldout_n_child), 4) AS weighted_heldout_confidence, ROUND(AVG(abs_confidence_delta_train_heldout), 4) AS avg_abs_confidence_delta, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN heldout_confidence_child_to_parent >= 0.90 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 4) AS pct_edges_heldout_conf_ge_90, ROUND(AVG(train_pct_parent_before_child), 4) AS avg_train_parent_before_child, ROUND(AVG(heldout_pct_parent_before_child), 4) AS avg_heldout_parent_before_child FROM dev_sean.matt.yt_channel_topic_taxonomy_inferred_edges_20260612 GROUP BY edge_strength), prediction_summary AS (SELECT edge_strength, COUNT(*) AS n_heldout_parent_predictions, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN heldout_parent_present THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END), 4) AS heldout_prediction_precision FROM dev_sean.matt.yt_channel_topic_taxonomy_heldout_edge_predictions_20260612 GROUP BY edge_strength), role_summary AS (SELECT empirical_role, COUNT(*) AS n_labels FROM dev_sean.matt.yt_channel_topic_taxonomy_label_roles_20260612 GROUP BY empirical_role) SELECT 'channel_summary' AS section, to_json(named_struct('split', split, 'n_channels', n_channels, 'n_nonempty', n_nonempty, 'avg_label_cardinality', avg_label_cardinality, 'distinct_first_labels', distinct_first_labels)) AS payload FROM channel_summary UNION ALL SELECT 'edge_summary' AS section, to_json(named_struct('edge_strength', edge_strength, 'n_edges', n_edges, 'weighted_train_confidence', weighted_train_confidence, 'weighted_heldout_confidence', weighted_heldout_confidence, 'avg_abs_confidence_delta', avg_abs_confidence_delta, 'pct_edges_heldout_conf_ge_90', pct_edges_heldout_conf_ge_90, 'avg_train_parent_before_child', avg_train_parent_before_child, 'avg_heldout_parent_before_child', avg_heldout_parent_before_child)) AS payload FROM edge_summary UNION ALL SELECT 'prediction_summary' AS section, to_json(named_struct('edge_strength', edge_strength, 'n_heldout_parent_predictions', n_heldout_parent_predictions, 'heldout_prediction_precision', heldout_prediction_precision)) AS payload FROM prediction_summary UNION ALL SELECT 'role_summary' AS section, to_json(named_struct('empirical_role', empirical_role, 'n_labels', n_labels)) AS payload FROM role_summary ORDER BY section, payload
